message.content:
```prolog
:- module(main, [main/0]).
:- set_prolog_flag(double_quotes, atom).

hanoi(1, S, _, E, [[S,E]]) :- !.
hanoi(N, S, M, E, Moves) :-
    N1 is N - 1,
    hanoi(N1, S, E, M, A),
    hanoi(N1, M, S, E, B),
    append(A, [[S,E]|B], Moves).

main :-
    current_input(In),
    read_line_to_codes(In, Line),
    ( Line == end_of_file -> true
    ; number_codes(N, Line),
      ( N >= 1 ->
          C is (1 << N) - 1,
          format("~d~n", [C]),
          hanoi(N, 1, 2, 3, Moves),
          forall(member([A,B], Moves),
                 format("~w ~w~n", [A, B]))
      ; true
      )
    ),
    halt.
```
